scripts.format: dotnet format backend/vu-calendarV2.csproj && dotnet format VuCalendar.UnitTests/VuCalendar.UnitTests.csproj && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.test:coverage: dotnet tool restore && cd VuCalendar.UnitTests && dotnet test --results-directory TestResults --coverlet --coverlet-output-format cobertura && dotnet reportgenerator "-reports:TestResults/**/coverage.cobertura*.xml" "-targetdir:CoverageReport" "-reporttypes:Html"
